name: 12553 · New Windsor, NY
findings: ZIP 12553 (New Windsor) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12553 (New Windsor) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 12553 (New Windsor) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
